gas_operations_wallet.purpose: TON fees and operational funding only; same Founder address, not a sixth VCOIN allocation recipient

notes: Template only; Mainnet deployment and every issuance require explicit Founder approval after all release gates pass.
Founder allocation is one immediate 420,000,000 VCOIN issuance with no vesting or time lock.
The Founder wallet also serves as GAS & OPERATIONS for TON fees only; it is not a sixth VCOIN allocation recipient.
Every issuance request requires exact transaction review, Founder wallet signature, and on-chain finality reconciliation.

Project owner confirmed the complete 2,100,000,000 VCOIN supply is to be allocated across all five registered wallets, with the Founder wallet included as one of the five. This is not authorization to deploy or broadcast transactions; exact Mainnet signing approval remains separate.

Predicted Master address and deterministic recipient Jetton Wallet addresses are derived from the unsigned Mainnet StateInit preview. They are not deployed/on-chain addresses until Mainnet deployment is confirmed.

The Founder wallet signs the deployment/funding transaction as GAS & OPERATIONS (0.75 TON minimum attached value with VCoinFund body), and signs the five exact VCoinMint issuance messages after deployment.
The previously configured inaccessible GAS wallet is retired and must never be funded or used.

Master and five deterministic Jetton Wallet predictions were regenerated from exact-head CI artifact 14744567066 (run 158), source commit c4a9831f8d751a0a714054014dcf9135622c9cce. They remain predictions until independent hash reproduction and deployed-Master get_wallet_address checks.
